UCC (Uniform Commercial Code) Section 2-315 specifically defines "Warranty of Fitness for Particular Purpose".
Conditions for this warranty:
1. Seller knows or has reason to know of specific purpose of goods.
2. Buyer relies on seller's skill or judgment to select the goods.
